title: Stage and member binding
summary: Sessions walk shared QA groups concurrently; a member whose owed groups are all held retains its claim and parks. Failed QA recovery rereads remaining blockers and run/stage/member/target evidence. A cleared dependency cannot change the old frozen target; a correction outside that lineage requires a qualifying later deployed candidate. Case target_envs selects registered environments independently of optional stage_reason metadata; every target retains its own immutable obligation and acceptance evidence.
